2.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
3. On the complaint of Channappa dated 27.07.2023, FIR in Crime No.264/2023 was registered by the Peenya Police Station, Bengaluru, against Manjunath and other for the aforesaid offences.
In the complaint it is averred that the complainant's daughter Ramya was married to Manjunath on 20.05.2023 and thereafter, she was residing in the matrimonial house.
It is alleged that she was ill-treated by the accused persons in the matrimonial house.
This was informed by complainant's daughter to her parents over the phone.
It is also alleged that on 24.07.2023 accused No.3 had abused Ramya.
Thereafter, on 27.07.2023 Ramya had committed suicide in her matrimonial house by hanging herself to a ceiling fan.
It is in this background complainant had approached the police and lodged complaint, which was registered as FIR in NC: 2023:KHC:33388 Crime No.264/2023.
The bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C, filed by the petitioner before the court of XLV Addl.
City Civil & Sessions Judge, Bengaluru City in Crl.Misc.No.7371/2023 was dismissed on 19.08.2023.

sentences.text: It is under these circumstances, the petitioner is before this court.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner has re-iterated the grounds urged in the petition and has prayed to allow the petition.
6. Learned counsel for respondent No.2 - de-facto complainant submits that complaint was lodged by a mistake of connotation and he has no objection for grant of bail.
7. From the complaint averments it is seen that there are no such ingredients in the complaint which would attract offence punishable under Section 306 IPC against the accused persons.

For the purpose of attracting offence under Section 306 IPC, the act of accused persons immediately prior to deceased committing suicide should have either abetted or instigated the deceased to commit suicide.
Such ingredients are not found in the complaint.
Even otherwise the de-facto complainant has appeared before the Court and stated that he NC: 2023:KHC:33388 has no objection for grant of bail and the complaint was lodged inadvertently.
